### Twenty One Capital to Participate in Upcoming October Conferences


October 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-October-Conferences-2026.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that Management is participating in the following October conferences.


**Maxim Growth Summit 2026**


- **Dates:** October 12–14, 2026
- **Location:** Hard Rock Hotel, New York, NY
- **Attendee:** Steven Meehan, Chief Financial Officer
- **Website:**[https://maximgrp.com/2026-growth-summit](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmaximgrp.com%2F2026-growth-summit&esheet=54619343&newsitemid=20261012991771&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fmaximgrp.com%2F2026-growth-summit&index=1&md5=b8b883c31061b141b67354100b431ef3)


**Bitfinex: The Future of Capital Markets**


- **Date:** October 22, 2026
- **Location:** LAC Lugano Arte e Cultura, Lugano, Switzerland
- **Speaker:** Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer
- **Website:**[https://thefutureofcapitalmarkets.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthefutureofcapitalmarkets.com&esheet=54619343&newsitemid=20261012991771&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fthefutureofcapitalmarkets.com&index=2&md5=662741af41f171db3736eb9bf2d1742f)


**Plan B Forum 2026**


- **Dates:** October 23–24, 2026
- **Location:** Palazzo dei Congressi, Lugano, Switzerland
- **Speakers:** Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer & Nico Moran, Head of Communications
- **Website:**[https://planb.lugano.ch/planb-forum](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fplanb.lugano.ch%2Fplanb-forum&esheet=54619343&newsitemid=20261012991771&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fplanb.lugano.ch%2Fplanb-forum&index=3&md5=c24170518041c9e338aa9a20a44a6f1f)


To schedule a one-on-one meeting with Twenty One’s management team during these conferences please email KCSA Strategic Communications atXXI@KCSA.com .


**About Twenty One**


Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://investors.xxi.money/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&esheet=54619343&newsitemid=20261012991771&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&index=4&md5=0d20529efc1a97f30b4c9ac87610873c) .
